column1: # Every custom property declared by the Design System token stylesheets appears
# here exactly once, and nothing else does. `ds-check tokens` enforces both
# directions against the stylesheets reached from exports.tsv.
#   internal        --ds-ref-* reference values. Not an override seam; they may
#                   change or disappear without a compatibility event.
#   public-preview  --ds-* semantic roles. The documented mapping seam for
#                   consumer brands and themes. No role is public-stable yet.
# Value types name what a valid assignment must produce where the role is used:
